demo.program:
# United Arab Emirates — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is the capital of United Arab Emirates?", "Abu Dhabi"),
    ("What currency does United Arab Emirates use?", "Dirham"),
    ("What is capital?", "Abu Dhabi"),
    ("What is currency?", "Dirham (AED)"),
    ("What is calling code?", "+971"),
    ("What is internet domain?", ".ae"),
    ("What is driving side?", "right"),
    ("What is continent?", "Asia"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
